thread:
maria.docs: Quick heads-up — I opened a docs PR that tightens up our compact response fallback guidance and adds a small TypeScript SDK snippet for the 'envelope' pattern. PTAL when you have a minute. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 :wave:

tyler.eng: Thanks — will take a look. Is this the change that prefers a short JSON envelope instead of raw arrays for ambiguous tool outputs?

maria.docs: Yep. Current examples sometimes show bare arrays which break strict parsers. The new guidance recommends an outer object: {"result": [...] } and a fallback example for nullable items. Also added a tiny SDK helper to unwrap safely.

lee.product: Quick Q — does this affect any onboarding examples in the quickstart? We should avoid surprising existing users.

maria.docs: I only touched the function-calling and structured-output sections. I added a callout in the quickstart notes to mention backward compatible parsers and pointed to the migration section.

sophia.docs: I skimmed the PR — one link is stale (old design doc). Also the TS snippet uses an any cast; can we make it typed?

maria.docs: Good catch on the link. I left a TODO in the PR to update. I can change the snippet to use a lightweight type. Thinking:

```ts
type Envelope<T> = { result: T | null }
function unwrap<T>(env: Envelope<T>): T | null {
  return env?.result ?? null
}

// usage
const payload = unwrap<Record<string, unknown>>(resp)
```

sophia.docs: Much better. Also suggest adding a short example for parsers that accept both old and new shapes:

```js
function getItems(resp) {
  if (Array.isArray(resp)) return resp // legacy
  if (resp && Array.isArray(resp.result)) return resp.result // envelope
  return []
}
```

maria.docs: Added that fallback snippet and a note about preserving existing SDK behavior unless the user opts into strict parsing.

tyler.eng: I ran the docs linter locally. One nit: the new JSON examples need to be wrapped with language markers for syntax-highlighting in the book. I can push a tiny follow-up commit if you want.

maria.docs: Please do. Also flagged the stale link for replacement: https://github.com/redwood-inference/designs/pull/129 -> replace with /discussions/443.

ci-bot: build #2112 — docs-lint failed on 842: examples/json-missing-lang

maria.docs: Fixing now, will force-push a patch that adds ```json to the examples and updates the link.

ci-bot: build #2113 — docs-lint passed :white_check_mark:

lee.product: Nice. Can we add a one-sentence blurb in the release notes so platform teams know this is just docs guidance (not an API change)?

maria.docs: Good call — added a short note in the PR description and will copy to the release notes draft after merge.

sophia.docs: Left one tiny wording suggestion on guardrail phrasing (avoid 'always' when we mean 'recommended').

maria.docs: Addressed. Thanks everyone for the quick reviews :rocket: 

tyler.eng: Merging after CI green.

maria.docs: Merged and backfilled the quickstart link. Closing thread.
